'''Alliance Com Buoy 965C''' was a [[communications satellite]] operated by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Agent ZNT-8]] transmitted reports to the com buoy from the destroyed [[Dankayo Base]].
